'''Mission 46/N''' was a survey mission undertaken by [[MB1711-V]] of the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] in the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[The Graveyard|Graveyard]]. The mission found the ruins of the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]] still intact on [[Asteroid 7785]]. After this discovery, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] spread misinformation that [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] was found alive within the ruins of the palace as a [[Operation Yavin Kill Two|plot]] to capture the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]].<ref name="GoA" />
